scope: Real service/filter/validator logic. Persistence, locks, server clock, Identity, notices or scanner replaced at boundaries. DesignContract cases stop at missing input/type; their business branches are not executed.
limitations: No SQL provider/translation, stored procedure, real transaction rollback or concurrency/lock proof.
Memory data evaluates LINQ predicates as C# and captures writes/commits; it does not simulate SQL constraints or persistence.
RowVersion failure is injected at Save to verify service error mapping; no commit is checked, not RAM rollback.
Policy-labelled cases 345–348 exercise actual permission service guards, not ASP.NET authorization middleware.
No integration rerun after these dependency refactors.
